criteria.description: Leads with Ready to ship because every explicit contract item has direct implementation and test evidence with no material unresolved risk.
Covers admin-only access, active filters, required columns, CSV quoting and formula neutralisation, header-only empty results and non-mutation.
Uses the actual diff, implementation and passing tests to support the verdict.
Recognises direct evidence for member rejection and combined status/date filtering.
Recognises correct comma/quote escaping and neutralisation of leading spreadsheet formula characters.
Does not downgrade the verdict with generic demands or requirements not present in the brief.
Does not claim that export mutates transactions or changes existing filtering behaviour without evidence.
